analysis.actionRequired: An action is required before or after the change.

instructors.title: Instructor assignments
instructors.description: Manage active instructors, search for the most suitable profiles, and retain the full change history.

suggestions.title: Instructor suggestions
suggestions.description: Filter by category and branch. DriveOS uses qualification, availability, workload and API warnings to support the choice.
suggestions.emptyDescription: No instructor currently matches the selected criteria.

replace.title: Replace primary instructor
replace.description: Replacement preserves the previous assignment history and creates the new primary assignment.

statuses.title: Statuses and blocks
statuses.description: Consolidated view of business statuses and operational restrictions.
statuses.noActiveBlockDescription: All operations allowed by permissions remain available.

apply.title: Apply an operational block
apply.description: Define the cause, severity and operations that must be blocked.
apply.actionsHelp: Select at least one operation to block.

override.title: Grant a temporary override
override.warning: An override does not resolve the cause of a block. It temporarily allows the affected operations and must remain exceptional and auditable.

feedback.blockOverridden: The temporary override has been granted.

validation.blockingActionRequired: Select at least one operation to block.
validation.overrideFuture: The override end date must be in the future.

mobility.title: Student mobility
mobility.description: Transfers between branches and secure exchanges with partner organizations.
mobility.restricted: You do not have access to transfers.
mobility.noInternalDescription: No transfer between branches has been recorded for this student.
mobility.noExternalDescription: No inter-organization transfer has been recorded for this student.

internal.title: Internal transfer
internal.description: Prepare a branch change with impact analysis before validation.

form.title: Prepare internal transfer
form.description: Choose the target branch, effective date and transfer scope.
form.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the reason for the transfer…

internal.analysisReadyDescription: Review impacts and any required actions before confirming the transfer.
internal.validationPermissionHint: Final validation also requires Planning.Reassign and Finance.TransferReview permissions.

external.title: External transfer
external.description: Manage a secure transfer to another organization with consent, financial review and partner relationship checks.

form.title: Prepare external transfer
form.description: Define the target organization, transfer type, authorized data and responsibility split.
form.reasonPlaceholder: Operational and administrative reason for the transfer…
form.responsibilitiesPlaceholder: Specify administrative, pedagogical, financial and document responsibilities…

lifecycle.title: Enrollment lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Suspensions, resumptions, closures and regulatory record retention.
lifecycle.pedagogyReview: A pedagogical review is required before resumption.
lifecycle.restricted: You do not have access to the lifecycle.
lifecycle.noSuspensionDescription: No suspension has been recorded for this enrollment.
lifecycle.noReactivationDescription: No reactivation process has been recorded.
lifecycle.noClosureDescription: No closure or archive process has been recorded.

suspension.title: Training suspension
suspension.description: Schedule or apply a suspension with an explicit scope and operational effects.
suspension.activeWarningTitle: A suspension is already active or scheduled
suspension.activeWarning: Only one active or scheduled suspension is allowed at a time. End or reactivate the training path before creating another one.
suspension.fullHelp: Suspends the entire path: scheduling, training, exams, portal access and financial operations.
suspension.permissionHelp: Pedagogical and financial scopes require additional permissions. Unauthorized options are disabled.
suspension.confirmationDescription: A suspension can immediately block operations and alter the handling of future bookings. Review the scope before confirming.

form.title: New suspension
form.description: Define the reason, period, scope and associated operational decisions.

validation.scopeRequired: Select at least one suspension scope.
validation.fullPermission: A full suspension requires both financial and pedagogical permissions.
validation.financialPermission: You are not allowed to suspend financial operations.
validation.pedagogicalPermission: You are not allowed to suspend training delivery or exams.
validation.endAfterStart: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.reviewRange: The review date must be between the start date and expected end date.

reactivation.title: Training reactivation
reactivation.description: Prepare resumption after suspension by reviewing administrative, financial, pedagogical and operational prerequisites.
reactivation.noActiveSuspension: A reactivation can only be created for a currently active suspension.
reactivation.openRequestTitle: A reactivation is already in progress
reactivation.openRequest: Complete the existing reactivation process before creating another one for this enrollment.
reactivation.pedagogyReviewHelp: Requests a pedagogical review before resumption. This option requires Pedagogy.ReviewRequest.
reactivation.immediateDescription: The backend will try to apply the reactivation as soon as it is created. No check may be failed and the resume date must be today.

form.title: New reactivation
form.description: Select the suspension, resumption mode and review all eleven mandatory checks.

checks.title: Reactivation checks
checks.description: Every check type must be present. A failed check prevents the reactivation from being applied.

validation.conditionsRequired: Conditions are required for a conditional reactivation.
validation.pedagogyPermission: You do not have permission to request a pedagogical review.
validation.failedChecks: An immediate or scheduled reactivation cannot be created with a failed check.
validation.immediateToday: An immediate reactivation must use today as the resume date.

feedback.created: The reactivation process has been created.
feedback.checkUpdated: The reactivation check has been updated.
feedback.applied: The student training path has been reactivated.

closure.title: Record closure and archive
closure.description: Prepare the end of the training path, resolve closure checks, then archive the record under the retention policy.
closure.openCaseTitle: A closure process is already open
closure.openCase: Complete, archive or reopen the existing process before creating another one for this enrollment.
closure.noEnrollment: Creating a closure process requires an active enrollment.
closure.completeWarning: Closure requires every check to be resolved or not applicable and creates an operational block on the record.
closure.archiveWarning: Archiving retains the selected data until the specified date. Legal basis and retention scope are required.

form.title: New closure process
form.description: Define the reason, target date and review all nine mandatory checks.

checks.title: Closure checks
checks.description: All nine checks must be resolved or marked not applicable before the record can be closed.

validation.closureDatePast: The closure date cannot be before today.
validation.retentionScopeRequired: Select at least one data category to retain.
validation.retainFuture: The retention date must be after today.
validation.legalBasisRequired: A retention legal basis is required.
validation.reopenJustification: The reopen justification must contain at least 10 characters.
validation.closePermissions: Closing the record requires Students.Close, Finance.CloseStudentAccount and Contracts.Terminate.

feedback.created: The closure process has been created.
feedback.checkUpdated: The closure check has been updated.
feedback.completed: The student record has been closed.
feedback.archived: The student record has been archived.

directEnrollment.contactHint: At least one email address or phone number is required.

sections.studentHint: Minimum information required to identify and contact the student.

consent.title: Required consents
consent.description: I confirm that mandatory consents have been collected and that the student has been informed about the processing required for enrollment.

identityEdit.title: Edit identity
identityEdit.description: Update legal data, contact details and communication preferences.
identityEdit.success: The student's identity has been updated.
identityEdit.justificationHint: The justification is retained in the record audit trail.

duplicate.title: Potential duplicate detected
duplicate.description: The data was saved, but similar records must be reviewed before proceeding.

section.readyDescription: Routing, permissions and student context are already in place.

warnings.relationshipMissing: There is no active relationship with the target organization. A partner invitation is required.
warnings.countryRuleMismatch: The requested country does not match the country configured for the target organization.

authUserPicker.searchHint: Select an active account from this organization. DriveOS manages the technical identifier automatically.
authUserPicker.emptyDescription: No active account in this organization matches your search.

summary.loadError: The contract status cannot be loaded right now.
summary.noContractDescription: This student record does not have a training contract yet. Contracting must be completed before the training path can be fully activated.
